title: Wood Kiln Rental Service
source_quote: CCF is renting our selection of wood-fire kilns to the community, schools, and professional artists.
evidence_sentence: Cub Creek rents anagama and minigama wood kilns with three service levels: experienced lead artists with no CCF wood, intermediate with CCF instruction, or beginner with full CCF support.
evidence_quote: CCF is renting our selection of wood-fire kilns to the community, schools, and professional artists.
summary: Wood kiln rentals for crews of 2–12 artists firing anagama and minigama kilns for 3–7 days. Three service levels available: $750–$3,200 depending on kiln, experience level, and whether CCF provides wood and instruction.
cost_text: $750–$3,200 depending on kiln, experience level, and support; wood costs additional if not included
how_to_join: Contact CCF at hkreitchet@gmail.com or 928-607-5765 for mandatory in-person introduction and facility tour
bring: Bisqued pots; crew for loading, unloading, and stoking
pay_text: Kiln rental $750–$3,200 plus wood costs; 50% down payment required for intermediate and beginner options
